title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Skill-chip search on the four confirmed IDs, plus a title-skim of the unfiltered Engineering feed for Platform Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (no confirmed chip exists for either). Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: First run, September 19, 2026 — 4 of 6 keywords returned zero results outright; one plausible candidate found via unfiltered title-skim, but its rate falls below the profile's contract-rate floor.

rows.title: Sr Software Engineer - Developer Productivity
rows.location: United States | Canada + 2 more — explicitly Canada-eligible
rows.gap: Skill fit itself is strong (CI/CD, ArgoCD/GitOps, Kubernetes/Docker/Helm, developer-platform ownership, and explicit day-to-day use of Claude/AI-assisted workflows — directly supported by Marc's real AI-assisted-engineering practice at Énergir), but the $60–70/hr rate is well below the profile's $100/hr full-time-consulting-contract floor for this 40hrs/wk, long-term engagement — capped per the rate red flag rather than the skill gap.

notes_sections.heading: Keyword results
items: All four confirmed skill-chip IDs returned zero results this run: DevOps Engineer (1338), Site Reliability Engineer (8473), Cloud Engineer / Cloud Engineering (10001), DevSecOps Engineer (6831).

Platform Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer have no confirmed skill chip (confirmed again this run — searching the Skills filter for "Platform Engineer" returns "Skill not found"; the skills list is technology/tool tags, not job-title tags). Fell back to the unfiltered role=5,16 listing (1,394 total openings, sorted by recency) and title-skimmed the first page (~20 postings).

The unfiltered feed's relevance density is very low — dominated by unrelated freelance gigs (LATAM Salesforce/CMS/QA roles, CNC programming, iOS, LLM data annotation) rather than infrastructure/DevOps work. Only 2 of the ~20 postings skimmed were even topically adjacent: the TaskRabbit role (scored above) and a US-only DevOps Cloud Engineer posting (ineligible).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: First-ever run against this source. No prior report data existed to compare against.
Browser-driven throughout, per the skill's requirement (client-side rendered, direct HTTP returns an empty shell).
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred; no account created or profile submitted.

Given how thin the unfiltered feed is for this domain, a full page-2+ title-skim wasn't run this pass — worth revisiting if this source is checked again, but the zero-result pattern across all 4 real skill-chip searches suggests Braintrust currently has very little SRE/Platform/DevOps-specific demand, not a search-mechanism failure.
